Frozen REL_INC transfers to fresh tall 3x7-k3 with zero scalar contradictions and full observed interaction-span recovery, but that carrier does not require degree two for scalar decoding.
The remaining evaluator complexity has shifted from discovering pair existence to deriving phase grading and coefficient valuation on frontier-relative interaction classes.
